segments.thig3.2:2.1: “Sā bhikkhuniṃ upagacchiṃ, yā me saddhāyikā ahu;
segments.thig3.2:3.1: “Tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna, yathā maṃ anusāsi sā;

lines: Tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvānāti tassā paṭisambhidāppattāya theriyā santike khandhādivibhāgapubbaṅgamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ pāpetvā desitasaṇhasukhumavipassanādhammaṃ sutvā.
Yathā maṃ anusāsi sāti sā therī yathā maṃ anusāsi ovadi, tathā paṭipajjantī paṭipattiṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvāpi sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdiṃ.
Aṭṭhamiyā pāde pasāresiṃ, tamokhandhaṃ padāliyāti anavasesaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ aggamaggena padāletvā aṭṭhame divase pallaṅkaṃ bhindantī pāde pasāresiṃ.
